name: pra-core-30-v1
description: Three-paper retrieval benchmark with manually selected, exact chunk excerpts. Chinese cases exercise cross-lingual retrieval; English cases exercise lexical and semantic retrieval.

cases.query: CRAB identifies what two root causes of popularity bias in generative recommendation?

relevant.evidence_excerpt: imbalanced tokenization inherits and can further amplify popularity
relevant.note: Abstract statement of the first root cause.

answer_review.answer: The paper attributes the bias to imbalanced tokenization and training that favors popular tokens [E:ev_78ce9b9a9e3d0f6549b2f52dd1d78656f2b2a7f2a19949af7274eee4da5b7f34].
answer_review.note: Citation scope is machine-checkable; semantic support awaits human review.

cases.query: CRAB 如何定义 popular items？

relevant.evidence_excerpt: top 20% of items by historical interaction frequency as popular

cases.query: What are the two stages of the CRAB debiasing method?

relevant.evidence_excerpt: second stage, we introduce a hierarchy-aware regularizer

cases.query: CRAB 按流行度把 token 分成哪三个组，比例是多少？

relevant.note: The same chunk also defines the 5%-95% neutral and remaining 5% unpopular groups.

cases.query: How is splitting an over-popular token formulated in CRAB?

relevant.evidence_excerpt: can be formulated as a regularized K-means problem

cases.query: 层次语义对齐正则项如何帮助新 token 和弱表示 token？
What is the joint optimization objective used by CRAB?

relevant.note: The chunk gives L = LRec + gamma LT.

cases.query: CRAB 的数据划分比例和主要评测指标是什么？
Which backbone, GPUs, epochs, and LoRA rank were used to implement CRAB?

answer_review.answer: CRAB uses Qwen2-0.5B, four NVIDIA A100 GPUs, 10 epochs, and LoRA rank 8 [E:ev_1734557e61d42258f0e240acfbcf1f134e883b4f4fd4e6b578c59aa8eea8c268].

cases.query: 为什么 CRAB 不宜过度拆分 popular tokens？

relevant.evidence_excerpt: over-splitting tokens may disrupt the semantic integrity

cases.query: How large can a 64-dimensional FP32 user embedding table be for three billion users?
BACO 指出 Louvain 方法有什么固有缺陷？
What two cluster properties characterize high-quality sketching matrices in BACO?
BACO 的图划分优化为什么难，使用什么正则平衡聚类大小？

relevant.note: The same chunk identifies weighted exclusive lasso for size balance.

cases.query: Why does BACO introduce a hybrid weighting scheme for users and items?
BACO 的标签传播每轮怎样为节点选择新标签？
Why does BACO assign each user to two clusters?

relevant.evidence_excerpt: e-commerce users have multiple, evolving interests

cases.query: 完整 BACO 算法的时间复杂度是多少，迭代上限通常取多少？

relevant.note: The chunk states T is typically 8 and gives O(|U| + |V| + T|E|).

cases.query: Which metrics, cutoff, backbone, and loss does the BACO evaluation protocol use?

answer_review.answer: The protocol uses Recall@20 and NDCG@20 with LightGCN and BPR loss [E:ev_b3c2abf99e20644ddbf412381e101f20a2e993926b478f749fc26e8fd4e2b34e].

cases.query: BACO 在四个数据集上相对最佳基线分别实现了多少倍加速？
Why is online A/B testing not used as the basis of the RecoAtlas open benchmark?
RecoAtlas 的 comparative shopping 与 bundle shopping 对推荐集合的要求有何不同？
How does RecoAtlas handle invalid IDs, duplicate IDs, and short reports?
RecoAtlas 用哪三类互补视角评价报告质量？

answer_review.answer: It reports exact recovery, behavior-trained reward-model scores, and LLM-judge scores [E:ev_11e4a4ac7db14001ad6c251fa5142f8fcb11260768af917f816b0742462d8b6e].

cases.query: Why are LLM-judge metrics reported separately from behavior-grounded scores?

relevant.evidence_excerpt: do not necessarily imply behavioral utility

cases.query: RecoAtlas 每种方法一共运行多少个 agent episodes，工具决策最多多少轮？
What happens to bundle SetHit@20 when complementarity is added to search?
为什么 RecoAtlas 的规模与测试时计算实验选择 Qwen3 系列？
How does increasing the faulty-tool rate affect comparative and bundle SetHit@20?

relevant.note: The same chunk reports bundle SetHit@20 dropping from 0.392 to 0.124.

answer_review.answer: At faulty-tool rates from 25% to 75%, comparative SetHit@20 drops from 0.406 to 0.205 and bundle SetHit@20 from 0.392 to 0.124 [E:ev_ccaa4294ed9162685a4172aec16c55c2e2f897ce2dfc6e9a5aa1d0affb3157f9].
